senses.gloss: दत्त- + अनुयात्र दत्त- + अनुयात्र, adj. accompanied.
दत्त- + आत्मन् दत्त- + आत्मन्, (vb. दा), adj. one who has given himself (as a son to another), Yājñ. 2, 131.
दत्तक दत्त + क (vb. दा), adj., with पुत्र, Given to be adopted as a son, Yājñ. 2, 130.
दत्ति दत्ति, i. e. दा + ति (from the reduplicated form दद्), f. Offering, Ragh. 8, 85.
दत्रिम दत्रिम (rather दत्त्रिम, i. e. दद्, see दत्ति, + त्र + इम), adj. Received by donation, Man. 9, 141.
दातुकाम दातुकाम, i. e. दातुम्, infin. of 1. दा, -काम, adj. Wishing to make a present, Pañc. ii. d. 110.

दातृ दा + तृ, m., f. त्री, n.
 1. A donor, a giver, Man. 11, 9; Rām. 4, 20, 4.
 2. Giving in marriage, Man. 3, 172.
 3. Communicating, Man. 2, 146.
 4. A creditor, Man. 8, 161.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. δωτήρ; Lat. dator.
दातृता दातृ + ता, f., and दातृत्व दातृ + त्व, n. Liberality, Rājat. 3, 197; Hariv. 14414.
दात्यूह दात्यूह, m. A gallinule, Rām. 2, 56, 9.
दात्र 2. दा + त्र, n. A kind of sickle, Rām. 2, 87, 9 Gorr.
दत्त- + वर दत्त- + वर, adj. 1. one to whom is given the permission to choose a boon, Rām. 1, 1, 22. 2. granted as a boon, ib. 6, 19, 61.
